title: Howie Roseman: Zach Ertz one of the greatest tight ends, but love what we have

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Howie Roseman: Zach Ertz one of the greatest tight ends, but love what we have
sources.description: Word in early August was that tight end Zach Ertz has been cleared for all football activities after tearing his ACL last December, but the veteran remains a free agent with the start of the regular season a little over a week away.
